{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-831k","title":"Routable-address L2/local resolution: wire_is_for_local, stack unicast filter, source-route assembly","description":"Remaining post-AddrForKey IID-correlation sites from wuio (secure-CoAP slice landed as 4ca47bc4c3). These share a common design question: for a routable 02xx destination, the local/L2 check must be full-address equality against the local native address (or a full-AddrForKey->link-local-IID resolution via the pin table), NOT ipv6_eui64(addr) which slices the low 64 bits. Needs a unified resolution helper + the local native address plumbed to the wire-filter layer:
1. rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:826 — wire_is_for_local_stack: eui64=destination[8..]^0x02 == local_eui64. A unicast SCHC frame to the node's 02xx native addr is wrongly dropped. Fix: compare full destination against local native (ygg_addr_from_pubkey(local_public_key)) in addition to the link-local EUI-64 path; needs local native plumbed in (currently only local_eui64 is passed).
2. rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/util.rs:163/168 — wire_is_for_local: ipv6_eui64(destination)==local_eui64 for 02xx destinations; same fix shape.
3. rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/mod.rs:270 + util.rs:447 — ipv6_eui64 on source-route first-hop / RH3 next-hop (routable 02xx targets); next-hop L2 addr must resolve via full address, not slice.
4. rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:1646-1660 assemble_path_from — root source-route assembly matches native target [8..] against link-local parent [8..] (the protocol-defined alias). Post-AddrForKey a native target's low 64 bits are NOT the parent's link-local IID, so multi-hop source-route assembly breaks. Needs the alias re-derived via the pinned pubkey (native==ygg_addr_from_pubkey(parent_key)) or a parent_map keyed by both forms.
Verified by independent site classification. The secure-CoAP pair (rpl_stack/secure.rs:143, secure.rs:1139/1287) was fixed in the wuio slice 4ca47bc4c3.
